answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor that signs a fresh proof every epoch; standing then accretes slowly, layer by layer like a pearl, only as already-established peers in separate funding clusters co-sign its audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its vouches fold back and never span distinct clusters: each clone flares briefly like a comet then fades, its lantern of reputation never catching. Honest pays one anchor once; a farm pays a fresh anchor plus a slow climb per head.
